source.title: What open mathematics problem have you been occasionally thinking about for years? - Quora

trace.notes: Input normalized as a Quora HTML source, but the page body could not be recovered. Direct fetch returned a JavaScript/challenge page ('Something went wrong. Wait a moment and try again.' / 'Please enable Javascript and refresh the page to continue'). Exact-title recovery searches did not produce a readable copy of the same source page body, so extraction was not possible.

Failure mode classified as blocked_or_challenged. Attempts: original Quora URL via HTML fetch; exact-title search for the same Quora page; broader exact-title search to locate a readable copy of the same source. Rejected candidates were either the same blocked Quora page or different pages discussing other open problems.
